Definition: a lattice; (by implication) a window, dovecot (because of the pigeon-holes), chimney (with its apertures for smoke), sluice (with openings for water)
BiblicalUsage: 1) lattice, window, sluice; 2) (CLBL) chimney (lattice opening where smoke escapes)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
